overview_description.description: Vitally is a customer engagement platform for B2B SaaS companies to drive a world-class customer experience and eliminate churn. Vitally's easy-to-use platform integrates all customer data and provides a 360-degree view into the metrics that matter most to you, allowing clients to set up health scores and notifications, and create automation playbooks. Vitally.io is a modern customer success platform that teams actually use.

about_short_description.short_description: Vitally is a customer success platform (CSP) designed for maximizing productivity, visibility and collaboration, plus eliminate churn.

product.name: Vitally Customer Success Platform
product.description: A cloud-based platform that centralizes customer data, automates workflows, and manages customer success operations to reduce churn and drive revenue growth.

product.name: Vitally AI
product.description: An AI-powered tool that analyzes customer interactions to generate insights, identify churn risks, and automate customer success tasks.

product.name: Playbook Automation
product.description: A feature that automates customer success workflows including task creation, CSM assignment, and customer journey management.

product.name: Project Management Tools
product.description: Tools within Vitally to manage customer success projects, track milestones, and coordinate internal and external collaboration.

product.name: Collaborative Docs
product.description: A feature that enables real-time collaboration between Customer Success teams and customers through shared documents and task tracking.

product.name: Custom Surveys
product.description: A tool to create and distribute surveys to gather customer feedback and product insights directly within the Vitally platform.
